summary.tldr: Authorizes up to $11.1 billion in federal spending for 2026 to 2027 and sets rules for some of that money.
what_it_does: Authorizes up to $11,127,236,516 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for federal public administration spending in 2026 to 2027.
Treats the transfers of appropriations in the estimates as authorized on April 1, 2026.
Limits each payment to the purpose and conditions set out in the relevant item.
Allows some year-end accounting adjustments to be charged after the fiscal year ends, before the Public Accounts are tabled.
Allows some Schedule 2 amounts to be paid up to March 31, 2028, and says any uncharged balance then lapses, subject to the Financial Administration Act.
summary.background: The bill’s total matches the items set out in Supplementary Estimates (A) for 2026 to 2027.
